g.text: GENERAL TOLERANCES ISO 2768-mK. DO NOT SCALE.
ALL DIMENSIONS FROM THE MODEL AS MEASURED.
PROPORTIONS AND MOUNT GEOMETRY FROZEN AT GATE G1
DETAILED MODEL, SEVENTEEN ASSEMBLIES, GATE G2
KNEE ANCHORS, ANKLE PADS, LOOMS REVISED. DRAWING SET ISSUED
ASSEMBLIES DISPLACED ALONG THEIR DIRECTION OF REMOVAL
1. PART COUNTS AND MASSES ARE ROLLED UP FROM THE PARTS DATA: 927 PARTS, 185.01 kg AGAINST A READY MASS OF 185 kg.
2. MASS IS MESH VOLUME × MATERIAL DENSITY × A FILL FACTOR PER MATERIAL CLASS.
3. PART NUMBERS RUN RJ28-AA-NNN, AA BEING THE ASSEMBLY NUMBER IN THE BALLOON.
4. ASSEMBLY 17, MARKINGS, IS APPLIED TO ITS HOST PARTS AND IS NOT DRAWN.
5. DISPLACEMENTS ARE IN ROBOT AXES: X TO THE ROBOT'S LEFT, Y TO THE REAR, Z UP.
